description: Native shrub carrying brilliant yellow flowers straight through summer and autumn.
nativeRange: Argentina, Uruguay, southern Brazil and neighboring regions
ecology: A long-flowering shrub-layer legume that bridges the gap between the spring and late-season nectar plants.
wildlifeNotes: Attracts sulphur butterflies and bees through summer and autumn. Hummingbirds visit it too.
medicinalUses: The leaves are used as a gentle laxative, similar in effect to commercial senna.
